summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue $250 million in bonds for school facilities, repaid by a property tax of about $36 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes $250,000,000 in bonds and a property-tax levy averaging $17,700,000 annually while the bonds are outstanding to fund improvements for Carmel Unified School District.
tax.quote: To update local schools, replace aging roofs, failing heating, cooling, ventilation, plumbing, electrical and sewer with efficient systems; improve student/ school safety; repair/ replace old buildings and aging portables with permanent classrooms; update classrooms/playgrounds; improve disability access; shall Carmel Unified School District's measure be adopted, authorizing $250,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $36 per $100,000 of assessed value, averaging $17,700,000 annually while bonds are outstanding, with independent oversight/ audits, no money for salaries, exclusively for CUSD?

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding exclusively for facilities and safety improvements in Carmel Unified School District schools.
